attributes.name: logical_name
attributes.description: Logical name of the profile generic object

attributes.name: buffer
attributes.description: Data buffer containing profile entries. Each entry is a structure whose elements correspond to the capture_objects list.

attributes.name: capture_objects

element_structure.name: class_id
element_structure.description: Class ID of the captured object

element_structure.name: instance_id
element_structure.description: Logical name (OBIS) of the captured object

element_structure.name: attribute_id
element_structure.description: Attribute ID of the captured object

element_structure.name: data_index
element_structure.description: Data index for array attributes (0 for scalar)

attributes.description: List of objects whose values are captured into the buffer. Defines the structure of each buffer entry.

attributes.name: capture_period
attributes.description: Interval between two consecutive captures in seconds. 0 = not periodic.

attributes.name: sort_method
attributes.description: Defines how entries in the buffer are sorted.

attributes.name: number_of_entries
attributes.description: Current number of entries in the buffer.

attributes.name: profile_entries
attributes.description: Maximum number of entries the buffer can hold (buffer capacity).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the profile generic object (e.g. overflow, disabled).

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Trigger a capture of all capture_objects into the buffer.

methods.name: get_data_by_range
methods.description: Retrieve entries within a time range.

methods.name: get_next_block
methods.description: Retrieve the next block of data (for large datasets).
